newsitem.title: USA: Three bond issues planned for Wisconsin - official.
newsitem.headline: Three bond issues planned for Wisconsin - official.

text.p: Wisconsin has three bond issues in line for the next few months, Frank Hoadley, the state's capital finance director, said Thursday.
Hoadley said an $80 million clean water revenue bond issue is planned for early December with Bear Stearns & Co as bookrunner and Merrill Lynch & Co as co-senior manager.

Two competitive deals will follow, he said. In January, the state has planned an approximately $100 million general obligation bond issue, followed by a veterans general obligation bond issue in February.
